Three bouncing dots. `fill="currentColor"` so the dots inherit the surrounding theme text color (works in light and dark). Size is driven entirely by the className (width + height); the viewBox keeps the 1:1 aspect.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/loading.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { LoadingDots } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/components";
```
